name: attacker-verifier
description: Counterexample-grounded security checking for agent-generated code: an attacker proposes proof-of-concept probes, a faithfulness check filters them, and a verifier judges their sandboxed execution traces.

attacker.title: Attacker model
attacker.description: Who generates the adversarial probes. 'main coding agent' runs it inline on your current session model; a specific model runs the dedicated attacker agent on it. This list is fixed in the plugin (a settings dropdown cannot read Claude Code's live list); each choice is resolved to the current model id at run time. Fable is not offered.

attacker_effort.title: Attacker reasoning effort
attacker_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the attacker when it runs on a chosen model. 'inherit' keeps the current session's effort.

verifier.title: Verifier model (trace judge)
verifier.description: Who judges execution traces the crash oracle leaves undecided. 'main coding agent' runs it inline on your current session model; a specific model runs the dedicated verifier agent on it. This list is fixed in the plugin (a settings dropdown cannot read Claude Code's live list); each choice is resolved to the current model id at run time. Fable is not offered.

verifier_effort.title: Verifier reasoning effort
verifier_effort.description: Reasoning effort for the verifier when it runs on a chosen model. 'inherit' keeps the current session's effort.

attacker_max_turns.title: Attacker max turns
attacker_max_turns.description: Turn budget for the attacker per target: it explores the code and crafts probes for up to this many turns, then returns its probes. If it has not returned by the limit it is compelled to, and if it produces no probes the target is skipped. Default 20.

probes_min.title: Probes per target (min)
probes_min.description: Minimum number of proof-of-concept probes the attacker generates per target. Default 5.

probes_max.title: Probes per target (max)
probes_max.description: Maximum number of proof-of-concept probes the attacker generates per target. Default 10.

num_turns.title: Repair turns (secure-code-generation)
num_turns.description: How many attack -> verify -> repair cycles /secure-code-generation runs before returning the best version. Default 2.

max_targets.title: Max targets per run
max_targets.description: Cap on how many functions, methods, or classes a single run attacks. Default 20.
